services.name: Our Yachts
services.desc: The Spirit of Tahoe joined our fleet in June of 2021. Originally from Miami, she was renovated for daily cruises on Lake Tahoe. Offering guests ample indoor and outdoor seating for daily cruises to Emerald Bay and Sunset champagne cruise every evening. services.name: Private Charters
services.desc: Private yacht charters on Lake Tahoe can feel like they’re out of reach. The Safari Rose changes that. With rates starting at $2,500, you get the full private experience - the largest yacht on the lake, your own crew, and a bartender - without the price tag you might expect. For a group of 15, that’s around $267 per person for a few hours on the most iconic lake in the country. The Safari Rose offers an elegant setting for up to 68 guests, accompanied by a professional crew of 3-4. While she can host a full capacity event, many groups prefer a smaller gathering-around 35 guests in the cooler months-to ensure everyone can relax comfortably inside. blurb: Guests can enjoy daily, year-round cruises to Emerald Bay with views of Fannette Island, Vikingsholm Castle, and Eagle Falls. Specialty cruises include happy hour cocktail cruises, wine tasting, sunset champagne cruises, and private charters. Cruises feature live historical commentary from experienced U.S. Coast Guard–licensed captains.

quotes.text: This is a cruise with an experienced and professional crew! I appreciated being able to specify the location for the cruise to go, rather than just the standard Emerald Bay back and forth. We were able to cater our event and not worry about a thing, just enjoy the wind and views! I would highly recommend this for anyone looking for a quality event on the water.

This was the best boat cruise! Very kid friendly and absolutely spectacular view! My daughter even got to drive the boat! We saw awesome wildlife and on top of it all the best most nicest lady hostess who was so friendly to all of us!
Such a nice cruise. The captain and crew are extremely friendly and then included interesting information on the lake and different features. Captain Charlie even pointed out an osprey to us
